name: plaud-mcp-connector
description: Full-text transcript search and audio upload on top of the official Plaud MCP. Independent third-party plugin — not affiliated with or supported by Plaud Inc.

plugins.name: plaud-mcp-connector
plugins.description: Bundles the official Plaud MCP, then adds what it cannot do: full-text search across transcript bodies (the official query matches recording names only, newest 500) and uploading audio into your own library (the official tools are read-only). Independent third-party plugin — not affiliated with or supported by Plaud Inc.
